relations.relationship: Uses the contact zone to analyze cultural encounter under asymmetrical power rather than presuming coherent, equal communities.

relations.relationship: Reads Guaman Poma’s autoethnographic writing as a selective appropriation of colonial genres and languages for Andean self-representation.
relations.evidence_note: Pratt’s explicitly attributed reading in the selected opening; Guaman Poma’s original manuscript not independently read. Does not infer Pratt’s Indigenous identity, transparent access to every Andean perspective or unmediated authenticity.
